_from: docs/plans/trader-quests-2/PLAN.md. Star Trader quests 6 to 10: 5 quest-giver portraits, 5 story pages a quest and the Star Quest Legend trophy.

styles.a: Painterly sci-fi storybook illustration, deep space blues and purples with glowing planets and warm light, cinematic, hopeful and friendly, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.

pictures.name: giver-puddle
pictures.prompt: a round cheerful frog-person mayor with smooth green skin, big golden eyes, a tiny black top hat and a gold mayor's chain over a blue waistcoat. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: giver-gorbo
pictures.prompt: a big round friendly orange alien chef shaped like a pear, with four small eyes on short wobbly stalks on top of his head, a long curly purple moustache, a tall white chef's hat, a white apron and two thin arms. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: giver-zip
pictures.prompt: an excited young man race announcer with spiky orange hair, a shiny silver jacket covered in racing stripes and a microphone. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: giver-pippop
pictures.prompt: two small alien twin children, a girl and a boy, with pale teal skin, big dark eyes and little round ear-fins, wearing matching yellow overalls. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: giver-sable
pictures.prompt: a kind grey-haired retired woman pirate captain with a black eye-patch, a long dark red coat and a battered tricorn hat, warm smile. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: puddle-1
pictures.prompt: A round cheerful frog-person mayor with smooth green skin, big golden eyes, a tiny black top hat and a gold mayor's chain over a blue waistcoat, standing sadly beside a completely empty, bone-dry cracked mud hollow where a pond used to be, not a drop of water anywhere, grumpy frogs sitting on the dusty cracked mud. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: puddle-2
pictures.prompt: A round cheerful frog-person mayor with smooth green skin, big golden eyes, a tiny black top hat and a gold mayor's chain over a blue waistcoat pointing at a row of blue water crates, splitting them into three neat piles. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: puddle-3
pictures.prompt: A small scruffy cargo spaceship flying past three small dusty orange planets glowing with gold rings, a big blue water tank strapped on its back. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: puddle-4
pictures.prompt: Rain pouring onto a lush green pond planet, happy frogs singing on lily pads, a round cheerful frog-person mayor with smooth green skin, big golden eyes, a tiny black top hat and a gold mayor's chain over a blue waistcoat dancing with an umbrella. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: puddle-5
pictures.prompt: Close-up of a hand holding a glowing blue rain-drop shaped crystal, sparkling, a ringed green alien planet with rain clouds in the background. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gorbo-1
pictures.prompt: A big round friendly orange alien chef shaped like a pear, with four small eyes on short wobbly stalks on top of his head, a long curly purple moustache, a tall white chef's hat, a white apron and two thin arms, in a huge busy space station kitchen full of empty pots and pans, looking worried but funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gorbo-2
pictures.prompt: A giant glowing purple moon-melon and a huge round wheel of blue cheese with little comet tails of stink, on a kitchen table under a starry window. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gorbo-3
pictures.prompt: A small scruffy cargo spaceship zooming away from a space station shaped like a giant cooking pot, steam puffing out. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gorbo-4
pictures.prompt: A long feast table in space full of happy alien travellers, a wobbly rainbow pudding, melon soup and melting cheese, a big round friendly orange alien chef shaped like a pear, with four small eyes on short wobbly stalks on top of his head, a long curly purple moustache, a tall white chef's hat, a white apron and two thin arms serving proudly. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gorbo-5
pictures.prompt: Close-up of a shining golden spoon on a velvet cloth, stars twinkling in a window behind. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zip-1
pictures.prompt: An excited young man race announcer with spiky orange hair, a shiny silver jacket covered in racing stripes and a microphone shouting happily on a floating stage in space, crowds of aliens cheering in floating stands, a row of colourful racing spaceships at a glowing starting line. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zip-2
pictures.prompt: Four planets in a curving line across space, each with a glowing checkered checkpoint ring around it, a comet streaking past. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zip-3
pictures.prompt: A small scruffy cargo spaceship waiting at a glowing starting line in space, engines glowing bright, a row of three big round lamps above it, red, yellow and green. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zip-4
pictures.prompt: A small scruffy cargo spaceship bursting through a glowing checkered finish ring in space, fireworks and cheering aliens in floating stands. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zip-5
pictures.prompt: A shining silver and gold trophy cup with a comet curling around it, on a podium, confetti and stars. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: pippop-1
pictures.prompt: Two small alien twin children, a girl and a boy, with pale teal skin, big dark eyes and little round ear-fins, wearing matching yellow overalls looking shocked at an open glowing space gate in a garden on a little planet, pet bowls on the grass. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: pippop-2
pictures.prompt: Four cute cartoon alien pets running away across space: a fluffy white moon-bunny, a wobbly pink jelly-puppy, a sleek cat with a glowing comet tail, and a small spiky pirate ship holding a sparkly snail in a net. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: pippop-3
pictures.prompt: A small scruffy cargo spaceship flying over a colourful planet, a little cartoon pirate ship in the distance, a sparkly snail peeking out of its window. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: pippop-4
pictures.prompt: Two small alien twin children, a girl and a boy, with pale teal skin, big dark eyes and little round ear-fins, wearing matching yellow overalls laughing in a garden with a happy snuggle pile of cute alien pets: a fluffy white bunny, a pink jelly puppy, a cat with a glowing comet tail and a sparkly snail. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: pippop-5
pictures.prompt: Close-up of a small red pet collar with a shiny star-shaped tag, lying on soft grass with flowers under a starry sky. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sable-1
pictures.prompt: A kind grey-haired retired woman pirate captain with a black eye-patch, a long dark red coat and a battered tricorn hat, warm smile in a sunny garden on a little planet full of glowing beehives and big friendly space bees. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sable-2
pictures.prompt: A grumpy rusty old pirate spaceship with a big rusty red beard-shaped front, lurking behind an asteroid, red eyes glowing in its windows. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sable-3
pictures.prompt: An old rolled-out parchment treasure map glowing softly on a spaceship dashboard, with little drawn planets, a dotted line and a big red cross, stars in the cockpit window. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sable-4
pictures.prompt: An open treasure chest on a rocky little planet, spilling gold coins and glowing star-gems, an old pirate hat on top, stars above. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sable-5
pictures.prompt: Close-up of a hand holding a single shining gold coin with a star on it, a treasure chest glowing softly behind. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: trophy-quest-legend
pictures.prompt: A shining golden and purple trophy shaped like a big star with two tiny spaceships circling it and a ring of ten small glowing stars, on a soft starry background. Centred.
